info.description: REST API for the self-hosted CDN. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`. All errors use the shape `{ "error": { "code", "message", "request_id" } }`. Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header.

post.description: Uploads a single file using `multipart/form-data`. Options may be sent as form fields **before** the `file` part, or as query parameters. The real content type is detected from the file contents; the file name, extension and browser `Content-Type` are not trusted. For files larger than ~100 MB prefer the chunked upload API.

folder_id.description: Destination folder id (omit or "root" for the top level).

visibility.description: Defaults to the folder visibility, then the configured default.

metadata.description: JSON object of custom metadata (requires metadata:write for API keys).

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 (hex). The upload is rejected if the content does not match.

cache_tags.description: Comma separated cache tags for targeted purges, e.g. "release:v2,project:sentinel".

expires_in_days.description: Move the file to the recycle bin automatically after this many days.

When signed transforms are required (default) the URL must carry `s` — obtain it from `POST /api/v1/images/sign`. Parameters: `w` Width in CSS pixels; `h` Height in CSS pixels; `dpr` Device pixel ratio (1–4); `fit` cover | contain | fill | inside | outside; `pos` Crop position: center, top, left, …, attention, entropy; `format` auto (Accept-based) | webp | avif | jpeg | png; `q` Quality 1–100; `rotate` 0 | 90 | 180 | 270; `flip` Flip vertically; `flop` Flip horizontally; `blur` Gaussian blur sigma 0.3–100; `sharpen` Sharpen sigma 0.5–10; `crop` Extract x,y,w,h before resizing; `bg` Background hex colour for contain / flatten; `grayscale` Convert to greyscale; `wm` Watermark file id; `wm_pos` Watermark gravity (southeast default); `wm_opacity` Watermark opacity 0.05–1; `wm_scale` Watermark width as a fraction of the image width; `keep_meta` Keep EXIF / ICC metadata (stripped by default, GPS included); `s` Transformation signature. Visibility rules match `/files/{id}` (signed URL params may be combined).
